attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 3017860)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Doom:_The_Dark_Ages
Fandom (doom.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://doom.fandom.com/wiki/Doom:_The_Dark_Ages
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, marked "Perfect stub article"); it links Gameplay, Walkthrough and Table of Contents subpages, but none of them exists, so nothing was used. doom.fandom.com answers the API with about 167 linked articles, including "Village of Khalim", "Siege Part 1", "Siege Part 2", "Hellbreaker" and "Doom: The Dark Ages: Revelations"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 3017860 is the base game (the other match is the artbook and soundtrack). 14 of 38 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in the campaign chapter. The ten achievements from "Revelations Complete" onward (Praetor Suit, Chain Spear and its upgrades, Relics, Ritual of Power, the '93 Shotgun, Xal'Goroth) sit together at the end of the Steam list with low unlock rates (4 to 17%), so they are grouped with the Revelations Campaign; the data does not say they belong to it.
